Still a VERY Good game. I'm putting in more and more hours into this game and realizing that yes, it is as good as it once was. I haven't encountered a single bug, and the multiplayer still even has players! Regularly, I never have trouble finding a match, even in the middle of down-hours. If you ever wanted to play with your friends, I highly recommend it. Given that it was meant to work with Origin and not EA, the friend-joining thing can be a little awkward for some people but work just fine for everyone else.

As a rule, I'd give this a wholesome 9/10, with some minor issues here and there, but you can always just set up a custom match to grab your friends in the search bar with a custom difficulty and all to get the lobby you all want. The characters and weapons in multiplayer are all grinded for like it was before, and it is worth every penny.

The difficulty is even harder than I remember and it makes it all the more fun. The sheer amount of builds you can run and the weapons you use can affect the outcome of your matches, and I would highly suggest trying out characters you might not think you'd like. You may be pleasantly surprised.

That's to say nothing of the stellar campaign (Even though the endings sucked), the rest of the campaign was an easy 10/10 even now.

Fight on, N7. Show these Reapers what we're made of!

First of all, the gameplay is very fun. Especially the shooting mechanic makes you keep playing the game. It's one those rare games where the choices you make really matter. The characters and the relationships you develop between them are intriguing. But what I find most impressive about this game and trilogy is its story and universe. Although there aren't very video games about it, the conflict between organics and synthetics has been covered by many sci-fi products but I think mass effect created one of the best and most thorough stories about this conflict. So, I think this game with its predecessors are among the best games ever seen.
